summary: The fixed harness cannot reach retained-reference O extraction on either source version.

assessment.necessity_reason: O extraction is a supported behavior of the harness’s json_unpack operation. A valid parsed object can trigger it, but every fixed unpack format uses borrowed o extraction. No input byte can change those formats, and the other harness calls do not perform O extraction.

before.requirement: Extract a valid JSON value with O and release the acquired reference.
before.reason: The before source increments the selected value’s reference count for O. The harness calls json_unpack only with fixed o formats.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness’s json_unpack calls forward their format to the unpack implementation.

after.requirement: Extract a valid JSON value with O and release the acquired reference.
after.reason: The after source retains the same O ownership behavior. The unchanged harness still selects only o formats.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness’s json_unpack calls forward their format to the unpack implementation.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Fuzzer bytes select a variant and supply parsed JSON; they do not supply an unpack format.

assessment.comparison_reason: Both versions increment a selected value’s reference count for O, while o only assigns a borrowed pointer. The same fixed harness formats prevent O extraction on both sides.
